props.name: days
props.description: Oldest first — usually the last 90 days.

props.name: label
props.description: The service or component this row describes.

props.name: uptime
props.description: Uptime percentage to print, 0 to 100. Computed from `days` when omitted.

props.name: from
props.description: Caption under the left end of the row. Defaults to "N days ago".

props.name: to
props.description: Caption under the right end of the row.

props.name: showLegend
props.description: Show the status key under the row.
